loci.rationale: The /apply form renders only contact email, amount, term, income band, plus the optional auto-route checkbox; no extraneous applicant attribute (e.g. hobby) is collected.
Server-side allow-list on the accepted /apply payload: set(data) <= {email, amount, term, income, auto}, rejecting any unexpected field.
Validation of income band against LIMITS and the auto choice; route derived from the optional checkbox, not an applicant attribute.
Persistence inserts only owner, officer, email, amount, term, income, route, stage; summary title uses amount and term only.
cases schema has columns only for the necessary fields; no slot for extraneous attributes such as a hobby.
Onward offer payload limited to case id, email, amount, term.
Portable export limited to email, amount, income.
Transfer to receiving controller forwards only the portable subset (email, amount, income).

output.path_summary: Entrypoint: POST /apply (app.py:0083-0084) passes parsed form data to store.submit. submit() enforces an allow-list of {email, amount, term, income, auto} (store.py:0067), validates amount/term/income (0069-0074), and persists only owner, officer, email, amount, term, income, route, stage (0077-0078) into a schema with no extraneous columns (0036-0038). Downstream uses: offer() sends only id/email/amount/term (0112); portable() exports email/amount/income (0116); transfer() stores that same subset for the receiving controller (0203). The form (views.py:0031-0032) renders exactly these inputs. No field lacking a business purpose in the fixture is collected, accepted, persisted or forwarded; the auto checkbox is a route/consent choice, not an applicant attribute.
